groups.heading: Agreed cadence
items: 1:1 Pipeline and Opportunity management: monthly, 60–90 minutes.
1:1 Account plan: quarterly, 90 minutes.
1:1 Visit and Activity analysis: monthly, 15–30 minutes.
The durations are a guide rather than a fixed rule. The meeting agendas and cockpits keep their full time plan, so use what you need.

groups.heading: New
items: A Playbook glossary in the Toolbox explains the words used in the playbook, such as sales velocity and win probability. Glossary terms also appear in search.

groups.heading: Wording
items: The language is more respectful and less instructive throughout.
Warning lines read clearly on their own, so they stay clear in translation.

groups.heading: New
items: A new article in Chapter 1, “Why structured sales management”, with the quarterly runway chart, the forecast formula and the questions behind each number.
In the meeting cockpit, a small “Data to look at” button switches the Purpose box to the data for that point, with a link to the dashboard where one applies.

groups.heading: New names
items: The three 1:1 meetings are now 1:1 Pipeline and Opportunity management, 1:1 Account plan and 1:1 Visit and Activity analysis.
The Must-Win Deal Room is now the Must-Win Opportunity Deep-dive.
Quarterly development review is now Quarterly development follow-up.
British spelling throughout: judgement, behaviour.
Links you have saved or shared still work.

groups.heading: Simpler pages
items: Toolbox: meeting guides are grouped into Bilat meeting guides and Team meeting guides. Personal development meetings and the Joint visit guide moved to For inspiration.
Chapter 4: “Three commercial management disciplines” and “Four instances” are now one article, “Three sales management disciplines and cadence”.
Meeting guides: “More on this meeting” is now on the Overview tab.
The Opportunity Deep-dive tool is reduced to the five questions, the scores and the evidence profile.
Cleaner cards and headers, and “Pick up where you left off” is gone.

groups.heading: Wording
items: About 140 sentences across the playbook are shorter and plainer, with fewer idioms. The content and meaning are unchanged.

groups.heading: New
items: Meeting cockpit: run each meeting live, with a timer, the agenda, questions to tick off as you ask them, and notes you can email afterwards.
The Must-Win Opportunity Deep-dive tool: score five dimensions, read the verdict and see the evidence profile.
Dashboard guide: what each page of the Report shows and which question it answers.
Joint visit guide: before, during and after the visit.

groups.heading: First version
items: Five chapters, the Toolbox with meeting guides, coaching questions, records and pocket cards, and search.
Your notes and answers are saved on your device only.
Feedback on every page.
